query_ru: Russian explanation of the same intent, not sent by the default benchmark
judgment_method: Initial curated seed labels based on dataset descriptions and film subjects; not generated by the evaluated retriever and not a human-approved exhaustive ground truth.

relevance_grades.3: Direct match to the main query intent
relevance_grades.2: Relevant but broader or with a secondary match
relevance_grades.1: Weak match, normally not counted relevant in binary metrics

ordering: The relevant_movies array is a set of graded judgments, not a mandatory exact ranking.
unjudged_policy: Unlisted movies get grade 0 for computation, but may in reality be relevant. Recall and AP refer only to this known label pool.
split: development_seed; do not tune and report final generalization on the same queries
